derivation.transform: Flatten each source testResults[] entry's assertionResults[] in reporter order. Emit one JSONL object per assertion with file relative to repository root, fullName, status normalized to passed|failed|skipped, and durationMs copied from the assertion duration. Pending/todo/non-passed, non-failed statuses normalize to skipped.
derivation.analysisPerFileElapsed: analysis.json per-file durationMs is derived from each raw testResults[] entry's endTime - startTime in milliseconds (file elapsed), rounded to three decimal places; it is not the sum of case durationMs.
